report='''# Agentic branch review — attempt 02

**PASS: requested independent source coverage and triage completed.** Eight fresh reviewers covered all 75 supplied path/lens pairs across all 50 admitted files. No actionable changed-line defect was confirmed. Fourteen investigated regression hypotheses are retained as rejected, with source-based reasons; no finding was deferred or waived.

This result means review completion. It grants neither implementation authority nor branch readiness or optical acceptance.

## Scope and identity

The caller's frozen comparison is `47b27a159caeb14e10f0d0ca349544ea42800056` → `2705cc7987705110e938aaa14595826370d5d27b`. Scope admission, accepted intent and the supplied snapshot were consumed unchanged. Snapshot ID: `0410b30696fc74705ba5828e354675662868b4fc8e9baf45b7fae9d4196ab08a`.

Before/after checks cover all 964 supplied file hashes and modes, HEAD and logical index. Every assignment and every retained inspected dependency is in the caller snapshot. No missing support or source drift was observed. The excluded VisualTrueType gitlink was not inspected.

## Independent coverage

Each reviewer received only its bounded packet, with no conversation history. All used an explicit `gpt-6.1-sol` model override and a distinct canonical agent session. `astra_approved=false`; no configured role or Astra fallback was used.

| Lane / session suffix | Files | Path/lens pairs | Native response |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |

| crossing_review | 9 | 10 | [Crossing](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/reviewers/crossing/native-response.md) |
| system_review | 5 | 10 | [Attached/joint/system/QP](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/reviewers/system/native-response.md) |
| curves_review | 5 | 7 | [Curves/source width/orientation/caps](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/reviewers/curves/native-response.md) |
| evaluation_review | 9 | 12 | [Evaluation/surface/probe](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/reviewers/evaluation/native-response.md) |
| specimen_review | 5 | 8 | [Specimen/configuration/CLI](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/reviewers/specimen/native-response.md) |

| playdate_review | 2 | 4 | [Playdate](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/reviewers/playdate/native-response.md) |

Sessions have the `/root/` prefix. [Coverage](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/coverage.json) records every exact assignment, full assigned-file inspection, bounded supporting dependencies, actual model selection, session and native report. [Inspected inputs](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/reviewers/inspected-inputs.json) and [orchestration provenance](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/reviewers/orchestration.json) retain the detailed inventories.

The collaboration API exposes the selected model and canonical session, but no separate backend self-introspection or opaque session UUID. The Playdate reviewer initially lacked that metadata; its unchanged native response is accompanied by a [provenance supplement](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/reviewers/playdate/provenance-supplement.md) acknowledging the explicit model selection. Some reviewers read policy documents before explicitly checking snapshot membership; subsequent checks confirmed that all were supplied and unchanged.

## Triage

[Findings](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/findings.json) retains `AR-R001`–`AR-R014` as rejected hypotheses, including topology traversal/exterior handling, bitmap constructor safety, fitting arithmetic and ownership, replay/error order, admission immutability, preview routing, comparison length guards, web lifecycle and parser precedence. The parent checked the current source and relevant frozen-base hunks before accepting these dispositions. Full native reports retain further challenges and their reasons. There are **zero confirmed OPEN findings** and no suggested implementation task.

The reviews traced numerical primitives through their actual constructors and callers. Artificial malformed private geometry was not promoted into a production finding. Tests were assessed for explicit observable contracts and their limits, including helper-only fixtures and frozen compatibility expectations. Author success claims were not used as execution evidence.

## Verification and limits

[Commands and exits](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/verification/commands.json) retain read-only currentness/output checks. [Before](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/verification/snapshot-before.json) and [after](sources/agentic-review/attempts/02/verification/snapshot-after.json) checks passed. No reviewer requested execution to resolve a surviving hypothesis, so no tests, builds, browser sessions, SDK commands, corpus sweeps or external-reference regeneration were run.
